The race travels through several of the region's most scenic areas, including the Cuyahoga Valley National Park and the Summit Metro Parks.

1st place - $1000 cash each race

races.name: City of Solon 5K
races.description:
Join us in the vibrant City of Solon for an exhilarating 5K run and a fun-filled Kids Donut Dash!

The 5K route winds through the scenic streets of Solon and is a flat course suitable for all skill levels.

Before the race, kids can participate in the Donut Dash, where they'll enjoy a short dash and tasty treats.

races.description:
Unique 5K & Fun Run taking place in the beautiful mountains of Harlan, KY! Mild course that wraps around a section of Martin Fork Lake. Raising awareness for coal miners affected from coal miner pneumoconiosis (Black Lung)

The 5K Run will be timed, and medals will be awarded! 🥇

Our races consist of a US Track & Field certified 5K Run/Walk, a US Track & Field certified 10K Run/Walk, the OAM Combo 5K +10K Run/Walk Coastie Challenge, and a 1 Mile Family Fun Run/Walk (be sure to bring your wagon or stroller).

races.name: Colors for Hope 5K
races.description: The Ava VanderStelt Scholarship Colors for Hope 5K is a vibrant and heartfelt community event created in memory of Ava Rose VanderStelt, who tragically lost her life to suicide in 2022. This meaningful event shines a light on mental health awareness while fostering connection, compassion, and support. Participants gather for a powerful day of remembrance, hope, fun, and fitness—united in a shared commitment to making a difference.

races.name: Cudahy Classic
races.description: The Cudahy Classic is one of the Badgerland Striders' Premiere running events of the summer. The race features a cross-country style start leading runners to the Oak Leaf Trail. The ten-mile event is two laps of a mostly flat and fast course, with the shorter five-mile event as a nice complement for those looking for less distance. Enjoy the charm of Sheridan Park as well as the stunning views of Lake Michigan and downtown Milwaukee.

Join us for the 3rd Annual Mustang Dash 5K!  

Pre-registered individuals can pick up their shirts starting at 7:30 am at the Portage Football Stadium.  The race will begin at 8:30 am.  All runners/walkers will travel through our town of Portage:  past the football stadium, up to Main Street, and through Crichton McCormick Park.  The 5k will end with a lap through the football stadium.

There will be prizes awarded to the first 5 males and first 5 females to cross the finish line!

races.description:

races.name: Nemesis 5k Color Run
races.description: A 5k color run through downtown Reading,Pa bringing the community together through fitness and fun. Color stations at every 200 meter marker. Music throughout the race course and festivities pre & post race. Please arrive between 1 & 3pm for packet pick up. The run will start promptly at 3:15pm. After the run please stay and enjoy the food vendors, entertainment and block party.

races.name: New Path Back to School 5K and Virtual 5K
races.description: New Path’s Weekend Food Program delivers over 450 food bags weekly to 17 schools and programs in Barrow County to be distributed to food-insecure students. Race proceeds will benefit Barrow County Schools' students in need.  This race will raise funds to support this important program.

races.name: NEW! SHARK EXHIBIT
races.description:
NEW SHARK EXHIBIT

Saturday, August 8, 11Am, FREE

Have you heard that shark sightings have been more prominent recently in San Diego? Let’s go check them out at the NEW SeaWorld exhibit where we will see them up close and personal.

races.name: North Fayette 5k
races.description:
Celebrating its 31st year, the race begins and ends at the North Fayette Community Center and follows Donaldson Road. Pace yourself for the monster hill up to Donaldson Park, where you will run a lap around the walking trail.

  • Pre-register for any of the 3 races by July 25th to guarantee your T-Shirt Size

  • There will be aid stations and water at midpoint and finish
  • Prizes are awarded to the top male and female 5k finish

races.description: Join us on Saturday, August 8, 2026 for the 10th annual Noyo Headlands Race. This year we'll have a half marathon, 10K run, 5k run, 5k fun walk, and half-mile kids' run along the stunning coastal trail in Fort Bragg, CA. races.description:
Join the Louisville Bicycle Club for the 46th Annual Old Kentucky Home Bicycle Tour (OKHT) and experience the beauty of a Kentucky summer from the saddle.

Set in the scenic rolling hills of Oldham County, this classic late-summer ride offers something for every cyclist — whether you’re chasing a 100K challenge or enjoying a relaxed cruise with friends.

Choose Your Distance

ANGELS: The ones who are able-bodied athletes and decide to run for inclusion! They guide the CAPTAIN to the finish line and help create special moments.

races.description:
Swim, bike, run…and have fun!

races.name: Ossian Fest 5K
races.description:
The Ossian Fest 5k is back for another great year! This year’s Ossian Fest theme is 250 Years of Stars, Stripes, and Freedom!

Whether you’re an avid runner, enjoy a fun frolic, or just want a family activity that everyone can participate in, this race is for you!

races.name: Outlaw Trail Ultra Half Marathon
races.description:
This is a point to point mostly downhill run starting high up at the Diamondfield Jack Campground and running north down to the Third Fork Campground.

The first 3 miles takes place on a the Deadline Ridge Road, a rough jeep/ATV trail; the final 10+ miles are on sweet single-track trail.

The name of the race “The Outlaw” refers to Diamondfield Jack who was considered one of the area's first outlaws. The start of the race takes place at Diamondfield Jack Campground.

  • Time: 8:00AM Start

Come join us for the annual Paul Ruston Memorial Run at Thomas Jefferson High School!

Lace up your sneakers and honor the memory of beloved community member Paul Ruston. races.description: This Paulding County Fall Festival 5K and fun run is a fundraiser for the Paulding county Fall festival to be held Friday September 11th and Saturday September 12th 2026.

races.name: Paws for Wellness Bearcat 5K Run/Walk

Grindfest is one long progression run originally developed in Milwaukee, Wisconsin in 2013. The race/workout has now been spread all over the world, arriving in Portland in 2019. 

The rules are simple - start at either 9 minute mile pace (wave 1) or 8 minute mile pace (wave 2) or 7 minute pace (wave 3) and progress 20 seconds every mile (3 laps to a mile at Benson!). You stay in as long as you can until you can no longer grind the pace down any further and you wave the white flag.

races.name: Half Marathon-by-the-Sea

races.description:
Another interesting themed event hatched just last year! And why the heck not?

While St Patrick’s is in March this event is a half year warmup  - so join us.

NOTE- the date of this event might need to be pushed to one week later 9/20 to avoid a local conflict.

races.name: First Solar HEROES 5k
races.description:
Please join us for the second annual First Solar HEROES 5k! We are thrilled to announce that we are partnering with the US Space & Rocket Center to host this memorable event. Come out and experience this awesome course that runs around the Pathfinder Shuttle and Saturn V Rocket!

This event will include a 5k race (3.1-mi) and 5k ruck. Both the 5k run and 5k ruck will have firm start and end times of 07:30 am - 08:45 am. The course that will be used is a USATF certified road course.

races.name: Fort Worth Marathon
races.description: Ready to test your running fitness and aim for a Boston Marathon qualifier? The Fort Worth Marathon is the perfect place to do it! Our course is officially certified by the USA Track & Field Association, guaranteeing an accurate and qualifying route. Run fast and take in the beautiful scenery along the Trinity River, Overton Park, and the Colonial area—it's a course designed for both speed and enjoyment.

races.name: Fostering 5K
races.description:
Lace up your running shoes and make a difference at the Fostering 5K race benefiting The Fostering Collective. Proceeds from the event will help strengthen and support foster, adoptive, and kinship families in the area. Every step taken and every dollar raised helps provide critical resources, advocacy, and support to bring hope to children in foster care.

Learn more about the Fostering Collective at https://thefosteringcollective.org/!
